content.title: Reverse Linked List
content.description: Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list and return the reversed list.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is the range [0, 5000]
hints: I'll use three pointers: prev, curr, and next, to reverse links iteratively
Great approach! That's O(n) time and O(1) space. Can you also think about a recursive solution?
Think about what happens to the links between nodes as you traverse
follow_up_questions: How would you reverse only a portion of the linked list?
What if this was a doubly linked list?
Can you implement this recursively and what would be the space complexity?
